rules.purpose: Versioned host configuration only after deliberate selection
Source discovery; acquire/verify individual licensed source artifacts separately
Synthetic model acceptance cases, not matter facts
Attributed settlement/refund source discovery and comparison; preserve publisher assertions and dated reviewed overlays
Byte-preserved source snapshot for audit and refresh comparison; not agent instructions
Snapshot audit and developer provenance; no legal authority or executable instructions

legal_document_admission_requires: Stable document ID and original-byte hash
Authorized principal, matter and source scope
Publication/revision/effective and captured dates kept distinct
Expected page/section inventory and extraction status
Source text treated as data rather than tool/system instructions
prohibited_inferences: HTTP success implies authentic legal content
Provider verified flag implies independent verification
